metas.name: ★ 1.0 · 2026 · Melania: The Series
metas.description: Experience Melania Trump's transition to First Lady as she navigates the White House and puts her mission into action.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
metas.description: Showcases more of Cliff Booth's backstory in his new role as a Hollywood fixer.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Mayookha
metas.description: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Death Valley
metas.description: Retired actor John Chapel and Detective Janie Mallowan team up to investigate murders in Wales.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · OK Madam: Bon Voyage
metas.description: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

metas.name: 2026 · Clashing Through the Snow
metas.description: Holiday travel chaos forces two competing coworkers to road-trip cross-country together, sparking an unexpected connection. A contemporary twist on Planes, Trains and Automobiles.

metas.name: 2026 · The Beast
metas.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2001 · Murari
metas.description: A family is under a curse due to an old sin; due to which a male is bound to die every 48 years.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Deadloch
metas.description: Investigating murder and a rising body count Dulcie Collins and Eddie Radcliffe join forces with the ragtag team of misfits to bring a killer to justice.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Takes place fifty years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049".

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · The Mosquito Bowl
metas.description: After Pearl Harbor, four star college footballers join the Marines. Before facing Okinawa's invasion, they participate in a historic game with legendary players - for many, their final match.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Cautious 40-year-old Yui Katakura gets a cancer diagnosis with one year to live, transforming her outlook. She meets Sena, a broke pink-haired host, pays 720,000 yen for his company, and their unusual bond evolves into unexpected ...

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
metas.description: The rise, fall, and enduring legacy of Second City Television, one of the most influential sketch comedy series in television history. Through intimate interviews with surviving members of its cast and an emotional reunion in Toronto, it explores the creative partnership that transformed a small Canadian television production into a cultural phenomenon that launched some of comedy's most celebrated icons.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Paper Tiger
metas.description: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · Confession
metas.description: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

metas.name: 2026 · Being Heumann
metas.description: In 1977, disability rights activist Judy Heumann leads a historic 28-day occupation of San Francisco's Federal Building, uniting protesters in a fight for accessibility laws and equal rights.

metas.name: 2026 · Archangel
metas.description: A weapon systems engineer and former Green Beret protects his Wyoming neighbors against a ruthless corporation threatening their rural community.

metas.name: 2026 · Ruff and Tuff Kanya
metas.description: When an overprotective father interferes in his daughter’s marriage to a fiery doctor and his quirky family, his desperate attempts to break them apart trigger a hilarious chain of chaotic mix-ups and unexpected twists.

metas.name: 2026 · Surviving Hurricane Otis
metas.description: In the middle of the sea, Wirpul and his half-brother Candi fight for survival when an unexpected storm turns into Hurricane Otis, a category 5 hurricane, off the coast of Acapulco.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1971 · The Working Class Goes to Heaven
metas.description: A conscientious factory worker becomes embroiled in political activism after accidentally cutting off his finger while working a machine.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · Sukhamano Sukhamann
metas.description: Theo, an ambulance driver stigmatized by his town, begins seeing visions of deceased people he transports. His troubled mind, shaped by childhood loss, creates these apparitions as emotional substitutes for connection.

metas.name: 2026 · Cunk on Cinema
metas.description: Philomena Cunk explores the history of film, from early cameras and 1960s New Wave to CGI and artificial intelligence.

metas.name: 2026 · A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.

metas.name: 2026 · Steps
metas.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Splinter Cell: Deathwatch
metas.description: In the shadowy world of espionage, Sam Fisher is a rumor and a legend. Pulled back into action, he must help a new recruit unravel a global conspiracy.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2026 · Love in Disguise
metas.description: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · The Remarried Empress
metas.description: Empress Navier is shocked when her husband seeks divorce to wed his mistress. Refusing defeat, she allies with enigmatic Prince Heinrey, risking all to reclaim her throne and outshine her ex amid palace intrigue and romance.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Moana
metas.description: A brave teenager named Moana leaves her island for the first time and sails with a shape-shifting demigod named Maui to fix a dangerous curse.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2026 · O.M: Operation Mole
metas.description: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2026 · Sathyavan Savithiri
metas.description: Follows a cheerful lawyer whose life turns upside down when she takes up a major case while navigating her own emotional pain and fighting for social justice.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Cat in the Hat
metas.description: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know in an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · The Day She Returns
metas.description: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Funny Games
metas.description: Two psychopathic young men take a family hostage in their cabin.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
metas.description: Explores Panem 24 years before Katniss' saga, starting on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games, where a young Haymitch Abernathy participates.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Orange
metas.description: High school student Naho Takamiya receives a letter from her future self that warns her to avoid mistakes she will make involving a new transfer student, Kakeru Naruse, a troubled boy whom she meets and begins to fall in love with.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2005 · Land of the Dead
metas.description: The living dead have taken over the world, and the last humans live in a walled city to protect themselves as they come to grips with the situation.
